svg.text: Universal Conic & Curve Generator — Build Blueprint
All dimensions in millimetres. 1 drawing unit = 1 mm.
Bill of materials (core set — all 4 required modules)
paired at pivot with protractor disc
Module 1 — Elliptical Trammel (draws circle, ellipse, degenerate line)
Slot lets both sliders and the pen block lock at any point along the beam.
Part C — Slider stack (x2), side section
SET-UP RULE: for semi-major a and eccentricity e, set b = a·√(1-e²).
Lock beam length (pin to pin) = a+b. Lock pen at distance a from one slider, b from the other.
Module 2 — Focus & Directrix Rig (draws a parabola; e = 1 by definition)
SET-UP RULE: thread length = exact distance from tie-point to the fence face (the blade's working length).
Tie one end at F, other at the eyelet; keep taut against the blade with the pencil to trace the parabola.
Module 3 — Two-Focus Rod & Thread Rig (draws a hyperbola branch, e = c/a)
SET-UP RULE: choose a. Cut thread length = rod length − 2a; tie the rod's free end to F2.
Pencil rides the groove holding thread taut against the rod edge = one hyperbola branch.
e = c/a (c = half the F1–F2 spacing). Move the thread to the rod's near end for the mirror branch.
Module 4 — Angle-Lock Ruler Pair (draws two straight lines crossing at angle α)
Part A — Rulers (x2, identical), shown locked at α = 56°
Part B — Protractor disc: Ø80, 3mm acrylic/paper, printed 0-180° scale, centred on the pivot bolt.
SET-UP RULE: e = sec(α/2) = 1/cos(α/2). Loosen the pivot wingnut, swing to reading α, retighten.
Draw along each ruler's edge through the pivot to get the full pair of crossing lines.
